sentences.en: The two felt the pressing necessity of earning a livelihood.
sentences.zh: 两人感到迫切需要谋生。

sentences.en: Many people have lost their livelihoods in the Sahel region.
sentences.zh: 萨赫勒地区许多人失去了生计。

sentences.en: The ordinary people had their livelihood in farming rice.
sentences.zh: 普通人的生计靠种稻米维持。

senses.zh: 生活，生计,谋生之道,营生
